96Yn_IiQUJI.description: In this video, we introduce how to scale testing within GitHub Actions via parallelization. As your application, and therefore your test suite, grows in size and complexity, it becomes important that your tests run as quickly and efficiently as possible. The way you accomplish this is to have multiple workers running your tests in parallel. Parallelization allows large test suites to execute in a fraction of the time when compared to running your tests synchronously.

hX9Br8QSYgc.description: An Exclusive Webinar with Cypress Co-Founder Brian Mann introducing Test Replay. The highly anticipated feature that enables you to understand the root cause of failures like never before. Interact with the DOM at the exact point of failure, and inspect network events, console logs, and JavaScript errors, without having to reproduce the issue locally in CI!

We also discuss how to setup secret keys in GitHub, which we can then use as environment variables in our workflow config file.
